plugin.name: Language Models
plugin.description: More model providers for the agent, each with your own API key.
plugin.longDescription: Adds model providers to Settings → Providers. Enter a provider's API key here or in Settings and its models appear in the model menu; the list is read from the provider, so new models show up by themselves. A provider without a key stays out.
config.commandCode.title: Command Code API key
config.commandCode.description: From Command Code Studio → Settings → API Keys, on the Provider plan. Claude models are only served through Command Code's own protocol and aren't listed.
config.siliconflow-cn.title: SiliconFlow CN API key
config.siliconflow.title: SiliconFlow API key
config.siliconflow.description: From cloud.siliconflow.com → API Keys. Its accounts are apart from SiliconFlow CN's.
config.modelscope.title: ModelScope API key
config.modelscope.description: Your access token from modelscope.cn → Account → Access Token. It has a free daily quota once an Alibaba Cloud account is linked.
config.stepfun.title: StepFun API key
config.hunyuan.title: Tencent Hunyuan API key
config.hunyuan.description: From the Tencent Cloud console → Hunyuan → API Key.
config.qianfan.title: Baidu Qianfan API key
config.qianfan.description: An API key from the Baidu AI Cloud console → Qianfan → API Key (starts with bce-v3/).
